name: Texas Multi-Blind Championship - DFW 2026

venue.name: The University of Texas at Dallas - SCI 3.250

information: The Texas Championship for Multi-Blind will be held separate from the main competition this year. There are two locations which will be happening simultaneously: [Austin](TXMBLDChampsAustin2026) and [DFW](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TXMBLDChampsDFW2026). See the [Texas Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TXMBLDChampionshipDFW2026#78972-texas-champion-titles) for more information. The [Texas FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2026) will be taking place at the same venue later in the day. Check out the competition page for more details, and consider registering for both! The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in the event. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)
